name: Projective TSDF Fusion
aliases: Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF) Volumetric Integration
definition: A method to compute signed distance values for voxels from calibrated depth images by projecting voxel centers into the camera frame and comparing projected depth with observed depth.
summary: Projective TSDF Fusion incrementally fuses depth images into a voxel grid by projecting voxel centers to compute signed distances, differing from static methods by supporting dynamic scale allocation in a multi-resolution octree.
